Jsw Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that at the Board meeting held on May 05, 2008 the following decisions were taken: "Formation of a Subsidiary in the area of Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings: Pre-Engineered steel buildings(PEBs) are gaining momentum in India. The Indian Corporates implementing large projects are increasingly using the Pre-Engineered steel buildings due to the distinct advantage of saving in construction time of about 30 to 50% in total project schedule, better look and durability. Considering the same the Board has approved the proposal to set up a subsidiary Company, to manufacture and sell Pre-Engineered building structures. The PEBs will consume steel plates, galvanised, colour coated and galvaume products thus giving a captive buyer for JSW Steel. In addition, this will be an opportunity for JSW Steel to enter into high-end solutions using Steel products as the base".

Jsw Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that "JSW Steel Limited as part of its CDM initiatives developed a 100 MW captive power plants using waste gases as a Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) Projects. Following the registration the company is required to appoint an accredited Verifier for monitoring and verification of the CER's. After this process of verification is completed, the company has to apply to CDM Executive Board of UNFCCC for issuance of CER's. The request for issuance of CERs will then be examined by the CDM Executive Board after following the laid down guidelines and procedures and there after the CER's will be issued. It may be noted that the volume of CER's may vary during this process of monitoring, verification and issuance. These CER's there after can be delivered to the prospective buyers. The price of CER's is volatile and the amount realizable depends upon the market conditions and terms of sale at the time of actual conclusion of sale transactions."

attchmntText: Jindal Vijayanagar Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that the AGM of the Company has been convened to be held on June 13, 2005.

Jindal Vijayanagar Steel Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on May 09, 2005, considered and approved the acquisition of Euro Ikon Iron & Steel Private Limited ('Euro Ikon'), Euro Coke & Energy Private Limited ('Euro Coke') and JSW power Limited ('JPL') by way of merger under a Scheme of Amalgamation of Euro Ikon, Euro Coke and JPL with Jindal Vijayanagar Steel Limited ('JVSL') and their respective shareholders under Sections 391 to 394 of the Companies Act, 1956. The Appointed Date for the merger is April 1, 2005.  The Company has further informed that pursuant to the Scheme i) Equity shareholders of Euro Ikon will be allotted 1 equity share of JVSL of Rs.10 each in lieu of 16 equity shares of Rs.10/- each held in Euro Ikon. ii) Equity shareholders of Euro Coke will be allotted 1 equity share of JVSL of Rs.10 each in lieu of 19 equity shares of Rs.10/- each held in Euro Coke; and iii) Equity shareholders of JPL will be allotted 1 equity shares of JVSL of Rs.10 each in lieu of 25 equity shares of Rs.10/- each held in JPL. Following implementation of the Scheme & issue of shares as above, the aggregate equity capital of JVSL will increase by a sum of Rs.17,99,28,360/- consisting of 1,79,92,836 equity shares of Rs.10/- each subject to minor changes upon rounding off of fractional entitlements. The Scheme is subject to requisite consent, approval of the requisite majority of the shareholders, lenders, creditors of the Company, Euro Ikon, Euro Coke and JPL, the Bombay High Court, and the permission or approval of any other statutory or regulatory authorities, which by law may be necessary for the implementation of the Scheme.
